svg.text: The recovery detector on a schematic goodput curve
SPEC.md §5; internal/detect/detect.go. A schematic curve. Goodput is the fraction of scheduled requests meeting
the §4 objective, over leading windows [t, t + R), so it starts to fall R before the fire; x is seconds from the fire anchor.
second shortfall, fire anchor to recovery
pre-fault level: the baseline window's goodput
equilibrium plateau: fire anchor + R to the pre-fault entry
every window starting in the hold stays at or above 90 %;
the last one ends at entry + 40 s
TTR to the pre-fault baseline = held entry - fire anchor
